description:
Search for cancer genomics studies in cBioPortal.
Data: cBioPortal for Cancer Genomics (public studies) · table study — one record = one cBioPortal study.
Key: studyId.
Arguments: cancer_type accepts cbio cancer type (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Public cBioPortal studies at the time of the call (existence only).

cancer_type.description: Accepts cbio_cancer_type; resolved to one cbio_cancer_type (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
